text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After finishing work, I head up to the roof and run into Admire Vega and Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh… Um, good evening.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Another one.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes. I come up here with Ayabe sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yep.
choice_data_list: The stars really are beautiful, huh.
The stars really are beautiful, huh.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You can see them so clearly tonight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Time passes as we gaze up in silence at the starry sky.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …I'm sure you can figure that out from my name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vega. It's a beautiful star that shines very brightly.
choice_data_list: Remind me… What kind of star is Vega again?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's a first-magnitude star in the Lyra constellation.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It forms the Summer Triangle with the stars Altair and Deneb.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …I guess so.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Isn't it also a famous part of the Tanabata festival, where it's known as Orihime?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's right.
choice_data_list: And it's a romantic star, at that.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: And you can't talk about Orihime without mentioning Hikoboshi.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You never know, Ayabe, maybe someday you'll meet someone who can be the Hikoboshi to your Orihime.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Or maybe you've already met them…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I don't know anyone like that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: And I'm happy staying alone… forever and ever.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I've been fine on my own so far. I don't need anybody else.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: But… ever since I arrived at the academy, everyone's been pestering me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: My favorite star? …I guess I'd go with Spica.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Spica—a wondrous star that shines with a brilliant blue hue.
choice_data_list: Remind me… What kind of star is Spica again?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Umm, I think it's…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's a first-magnitude star in the Virgo constellation.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It forms the Spring Triangle with the stars Denebola and Arcturus.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That's right. I've always thought the names Spica and Suzuka were kind of similar, so…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I was… half joking. I just feel a sort of affinity toward it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Although, it's less the stars themselves… and more like I love admiring the scenery alone.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: My hometown gets a lot of snowfall—an overwhelming amount, actually—and all the scenery gets tinged in white.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The snow flattens all the sounds of the town, and the only thing you can hear is your own heartbeat.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It's like I'm alone in a silent, pure white world. That's the landscape you'd see if you looked into my heart.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: But I haven't had as many opportunities to be alone since coming here.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I know how you feel… Everyone here is incredibly noisy.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I've always preferred to be alone, but everybody's… There are just so many people around me all the time.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ever since I arrived at the academy, everyone's been pestering me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Opera O, Doto, Urara… Even Top Road and Curren.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: All of them… They're so bothersome.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't even need to ask whether she truly means all that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't even need to ask whether she truly means all that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In contrast to the coldness of her words, I sense a warmth in her voice, like something trickling out from deep within her heart.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It seems neither of us can afford to stay as we are, can we, Ayabe?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: There's really an awful lot of busybodies at this academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The stars shine brightly in the clear sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as constellations tie the stars together, so too are people connected by the bonds they forge with one another.
